profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. It operates a cloud storage and file-sharing platform that, per its own site, offers secure storage, collaboration tools, and a product called Dash, which the company describes as a way to organize all company content in one place. The site also notes support for previews of more than 175 file types and synced team folders.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, which provides document summaries, sharing controls, and works with team data stored in the platform. The company's site states that Dropbox connects with leading AI platforms to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools, with built-in AI summaries described as coming soon. A third-party MCP server, listed under the name ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, enables external tools to search, browse, and read Dropbox files, including finding documents by name or content and listing folders.

Dropbox trades on a public exchange under the ticker DBX with CIK 0001467623. Its most recently reported annual revenue, drawn from a 10-K filing for the period ending December 31, 2025, was $2,521,000,000. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
